comment: Command language v1 — the battle set: 4 crew verbs (plan §3.2). Scoping: rate and helm are ship-global; oars and pressure take an optional side (default both); there is no per-tier scope (tiers of a side share one state). Deterministic, fail-fast: unknown verbs and out-of-range args are rejected before a run.

rate.intent: set the stroke cadence; ship-global — both sides listen to the same pipe
rate.comment: aliases provisional; racing 44 ~= ch.9 sprint 44.5 spm. cycle = 60/spm; drive/recovery split 33-45% (Table 9.6).

oars.intent: blade-water state, per side; tiers of a side share one state — their blades share that side's water (per-tier states would collide)

pressure.intent: effort per stroke; optional side — differential effort steers (one side pulling harder turns the ship)
pressure.comment: numeric anchors provisional; the ch.7 chain P = 7.43r anchors the steady reference and the absolute mapping is calibrated in Phase 2 (oQ-13).
